description: This file contains the implementation of the LeaseBasedQueueBalancer class, which is responsible for managing queue load balancing in a clustered environment using leases. It supports operations such as lease acquisition, renewal, release, and responsibility updates among silos, as well as handling cluster membership changes and maintaining lease health periodically.

classes.name: LeaseBasedQueueBalancer
classes.description: A class implementing a lease-based queue load balancer for Orleans streams, supporting cluster auto-scaling, fault tolerance, and efficient queue responsibility management across silos.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of LeaseBasedQueueBalancer using dependency injection.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the queue balancer with the given queue mapper, starting lease maintenance and acquisition tasks.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the balancer, releasing resources and leases.

methods.name: GetMyQueues
methods.description: Returns the list of queues currently owned by this balancer instance.
